messages.snippet: Dear Tom, Ahead of the CMC on 18 June, here is our draft of the agreed directions: Model C extended
messages.subject: Marldale v Crayford - CMC 18 June, draft directions
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

Ahead of the CMC on 18 June, here is our draft of the agreed directions: Model C extended disclosure by 25 July; single joint plant engineer to be agreed by 11 July and to report by 19 September; witness statements by 8 August; trial window from 9 February 2026, 5 days. Please let me know if Marldale agrees.

Nadia

messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Agreed in substance. We'd add that the SJE be instructed by 18 July and that written questions be permitted by 3 October. On the SJE candidate, we propose Dr Ian Petrie of Carrick Plant Engineering - happy to exchange CVs. Otherwise content with your draft.

Tom
